title: Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) Monthly Premium Rate Schedule by Tier and Age Band
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Monthly Premium Rate Schedule

**Schedule.** The monthly premium for Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) is fixed by two things only: the coverage tier the policy is held at, and the age band the insured falls in. The insured is placed in an age band by **age on the premium due date**. Premiums are stated and charged **to the cent**. Coverage for part of a month is billed as a **full month**. When the insured moves into a new age band, the premium changes: the new band's amount applies from the first due date after the insured enters that band.

## Face amount of each tier

| Coverage tier | Face amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | 50000 |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | 100000 |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | 200000 |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | 300000 |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | 400000 |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | 500000 |

## Monthly premium by age band (USD per month)

| Age band (age on the due date) | $50,000 | $100,000 | $200,000 | $300,000 | $400,000 | $500,000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 29 and under | 4.00 | 8.00 | 16.00 | 24.00 | 32.00 | 40.00 |
| 30 to 34 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 | 30.00 | 40.00 | 50.00 |
| 35 to 39 | 6.50 | 13.00 | 26.00 | 39.00 | 52.00 | 65.00 |
| 40 to 44 | 8.50 | 17.00 | 34.00 | 51.00 | 68.00 | 85.00 |
| 45 to 49 | 12.00 | 24.00 | 48.00 | 72.00 | 96.00 | 120.00 |
| 50 to 54 | 18.50 | 37.00 | 74.00 | 111.00 | 148.00 | 185.00 |
| 55 to 59 | 33.00 | 66.00 | 132.00 | 198.00 | 264.00 | 330.00 |
| 60 to 64 | 60.00 | 120.00 | 240.00 | 360.00 | 480.00 | 600.00 |
| 65 to 69 | 80.00 | 160.00 | 320.00 | 480.00 | 640.00 | 800.00 |
| 70 to 74 | 150.00 | 300.00 | 600.00 | 900.00 | 1200.00 | 1500.00 |
| 75 and over | 300.00 | 600.00 | 1200.00 | 1800.00 | 2400.00 | 3000.00 |

Each column is headed by the coverage tier's face amount (for example, the column headed $200,000 is VGLI $200,000 Coverage). Every tier and every age band has a figure; no cell is left to inference.

## Reading the schedule

- **Which band.** Take the insured's age on the due date of the premium being priced, find the band that contains it, and read across to the policy's tier.
- **Band change.** The premium due on the first due date after the insured enters a new band is priced at the new band; earlier due dates keep the earlier band's figure.
- **Part of a month.** A month in which coverage runs for only some of the days is charged at the full monthly figure from this schedule.
- **Cents.** Every figure is carried to the cent, as shown.

## Illustrations (hypothetical insureds)

*Hypothetical inputs, chosen only to show how the schedule is read.*

| Tier held | Age on the due date | Monthly premium |
|---|---|---|
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | 44 | $17.00 |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | 45 | $24.00 |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | 29 | $24.00 |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | 75 | $3,000.00 |

A hypothetical insured holding VGLI $100,000 Coverage turns 45 in the middle of a month. The premium due at the start of that month was priced at age 44 ($17.00); the premium due on the first due date after the birthday is priced at age 45 ($24.00).
